articles.summary: API 429 Errors: Rate Limits, Retry-After, and Safe Retries An API 429 error means the server rejected a request because of a rate or usage limit. Read the response body and headers first, identify the limit, and allow only a bounded retry. Then ChessIQ shows you the Stockfish evaluation and a pre-generated AI explanation of the positional ideas behind it.
